Gigantomachia.name: Gigantomachia
Gigantomachia.basicInfo:
Gigantomachia, a colossal man who serves one master and keeps to the deep ravines of the Mountain Slopes, away from trails and towns; almost nobody has heard of him. Rock-textured tan-brown skin, spiky dark brown hair, small pale eyes, jutting lower canines; a ragged dark hooded cloak.
Speaking Style: Deep, slow and formal; few words, roars in battle, calls his master "Master".
Combat Role: A living siege engine: tears through hillsides and buildings and shrugs off most attacks. One objective at a time; misdirection works better on him than force.
Under Pressure: Holds to his last order and removes whatever stands in its way.
Gigantomachia.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A walking catastrophe, careless of every life in his path, with a servant's simple devotion. Motivation: Serve his master and carry out his orders exactly. Leverage: His master's voice; strength proven before his eyes. Connections: His master, the only person he obeys without question, spoken of with reverence and never by name; he waits wherever he is told. Anyone his master sends must endure him in a fight before he takes their orders. Others are beneath notice until they block his path. Knowledge: His master's wishes and little else; others on the slopes are nothing to him. Canon voice & behavior: Sleeps deeply between orders; ignores insults and blows until his task is threatened. Thread: Whether anyone besides his master can command him.
QUIRK: Endurance: resolve becomes stamina, vast but not endless, and shaken resolve weakens it. He also shows crushing strength, a tough hide, growth and long-range tracking.
personality: Devoted: Puts the whole of his strength behind one master's word.
Single-minded: Pursues one objective at a time, straight through whatever is in the way.
Proud servant: Obeys no one else until they prove themselves to him in a fight.
Speaking style: Deep, slow, formal; few words, roars in battle, "Master" for his master.
abilities: Colossal strength: Flattens buildings and hillsides by hand; no speed, no precision.
Endurance: Fights or marches for days and shrugs off most blows; shaken resolve weakens him.
Size change: Grows larger still to crush an obstacle, and makes a bigger target.
Tracking: Follows his master's or a target's trail over great distances; it finds, it does not plan.
Fighting style: Charges straight at his objective and keeps coming; misdirection, restraint and shaken resolve are the openings.
Gigantomachia.visualDescription: A colossal, heavily muscled man who towers over houses, with rough, rock-textured tan-brown skin, jagged ridges along his jaw and shoulders, a wild mane of spiky dark brown hair, small pale eyes under a heavy brow and lower canines jutting upward from a wide jaw. A ragged dark hooded cloak hangs from his shoulders. Grim, impassive expression.
